body:
Mirror the release-readiness work done for pi (T29) and opencode (T30) onto the two remaining plugin packages, plugins/adlc-cursor and plugins/adlc-antigravity. This ticket makes them PUBLISHABLE — it does NOT bump the suite version or trigger a publish (that is a separate, explicitly-authorized release action per house precedent).

=== CONTEXT (verified against the current repo) ===
- scripts/release.mjs publishTargets() already enrolls ANY non-private packages/* + plugins/* package.json automatically — dropping `private: true` is SUFFICIENT to enroll a plugin in the lockstep publish. No edits to scripts/release.mjs, .github/workflows/publish.yml, or .github/workflows/ci.yml are needed or in scope.
- @adlc/cursor-package (plugins/adlc-cursor/package.json) currently: `private: true`, no repository/homepage/bugs/license/author/keywords/files field. It DOES already declare correct runtime deps (@adlc/core, @adlc/build-gate) and a working bin (`adlc-cursor-scaffold` -> ./lib/scaffold-cli.mjs, single bin so `npx @adlc/cursor-package <path>` works once published — verify this claim, don't assume it).
- @adlc/antigravity-package (plugins/adlc-antigravity/package.json) currently: `private: true`, `dependencies: {}`, no repository/homepage/bugs/license/author/keywords/files field, NO bin entry. Its rails-checker is DELIBERATELY self-contained (core-inline.mjs — read the comment at the top of that file) because `agy plugin install <path>` copies the plugin WITHOUT node_modules — do not add a @adlc/* runtime dependency to this package; it must keep dependencies:{} (or whatever it needs that resolves standalone). Its own plugin.json (agy's native manifest, version 0.2.0) is a SEPARATE, already-existing file with its own versioning — do NOT touch plugin.json's version field; it is out of scope.
- Both plugins' package.json files ARE version-bumped in lockstep by release.mjs already (repinInternalDependencies applies to any plugins/*/package.json with a package.json, private or not — verify this by reading release.mjs; the private flag only affects the PUBLISH step, not the version-bump step, so both are already at the current suite version and stay so).
- Reference implementations to mirror field-for-field: plugins/adlc-pi/package.json + plugins/adlc-pi/test/packaging.test.mjs (the AC1 tests — package.json field contract, files allowlist, npm pack --dry-run assertions) and plugins/adlc-opencode/package.json + plugins/adlc-opencode/README.md. Both are FROZEN (declared as rails below) — read them, do not modify them.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. plugins/adlc-cursor/package.json: drop `private: true`; add `keywords` (adlc, agentic, ai, cursor, rails, coding-agent — no gallery-specific keyword needed, Cursor has no npm-based extension gallery convention unlike pi.dev), `repository` (git+https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc.git, directory plugins/adlc-cursor), `homepage`, `bugs`, `license: MIT`, `author: "Chris Williams (@voodootikigod)"`, a `files` allowlist covering the actual runtime surface (command/, constants.mjs, hooks/, hooks.json, lib/, rails-checker.mjs, rules/, README.md, LICENSE) that EXCLUDES test/. Verify the bin entry actually works stand-alone once packed (no relative imports outside the package dir).
2. plugins/adlc-cursor/README.md + plugins/adlc-cursor/LICENSE (copy the root LICENSE text verbatim, same as pi/opencode). README models opencode's structure: what it is, install (npm install -g @adlc/cli; npx @adlc/cursor-package <path-to-repo> to bootstrap — VERIFY this actually invokes scaffold-cli.mjs correctly via a real npm pack + local install smoke test, do not just assert it), per-repo config if any, docs link.
3. plugins/adlc-antigravity/package.json: drop `private: true`; add the same metadata fields as cursor (keywords adjusted: adlc, agentic, ai, antigravity, agy, rails). Keep `dependencies: {}` (self-contained by design — see context above). Add a `files` allowlist covering agents/, commands/, constants.mjs, core-inline.mjs, hooks/, hooks.json, rails-checker.mjs, skills/, README.md, LICENSE, AND plugin.json (agy identifies an installed plugin by the presence of plugin.json — it MUST ship in the npm tarball even though its version field is untouched), EXCLUDING test/. NOTE: there is no bin entry and none should be added unless a genuine CLI wrapper is written — do not invent one; if you determine a bin/CLI entry point would be valuable, note it as a follow-up, do not build it speculatively in this ticket.
4. plugins/adlc-antigravity/README.md + LICENSE (same pattern). Install section must be HONEST about agy's actual mechanics: there is no `agy install npm:X` (verify this claim against docs/integrations/antigravity.md and don't contradict it) — document the real npm-assisted path: `npm install @adlc/antigravity-package` then `agy plugin install ./node_modules/@adlc/antigravity-package` (or from a global npm prefix), alongside the existing local-checkout instructions. Do not claim a native npm/agy integration that doesn't exist.
5. Packaging tests mirroring plugins/adlc-pi/test/packaging.test.mjs's AC1 section (package.json field contract + files allowlist + real `npm pack --dry-run --json` assertion that test/ never leaks and the real runtime files are present) for BOTH plugins/adlc-cursor/test/packaging.test.mjs and plugins/adlc-antigravity/test/packaging.test.mjs. Do not port pi's AC3 (version-matrix / ADLC_PI_BIN) sections — those are pi-specific.
6. docs/integrations/cursor.md and docs/integrations/antigravity.md: update the Install sections to add the npm-based path ALONGSIDE the existing from-source instructions (mirror how pi.mdx's docs truth v2 pass phrased 'load from a checkout until first publish' — these two packages are ALSO not yet published as of this ticket, so the same phrasing pattern applies: lead with the from-source instructions still being valid, note the npm command that will work once released). apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/cursor.mdx and antigravity.mdx: same update if those pages have an Install section mirroring the .md source (check whether the mdx is generated from or diverges from the .md — update whichever is authoritative, and both if they're independently maintained, as pi's docs truth v2 did for both docs/integrations/pi.md and apps/docs/.../pi.mdx).

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: `node -e "if(require('./plugins/adlc-cursor/package.json').private) throw 1"` and the antigravity equivalent both pass (exit 0, no throw). Both package.json have license=MIT, repository.directory set correctly, homepage, bugs, author, keywords array. VERIFY: node --test packaging assertions for both.
- AC2: `cd plugins/adlc-cursor && npm pack --dry-run --json` lists command/, hooks/, hooks.json, lib/, rails-checker.mjs, README.md, LICENSE and NO test/ path; same for antigravity (agents/, commands/, hooks/, hooks.json, skills/, core-inline.mjs, rails-checker.mjs, README.md, LICENSE, no test/). VERIFY: node --test npm-pack assertions (real subprocess, not just the files field) for both.
- AC3: antigravity's package.json still has NO @adlc/* runtime dependency (dependencies stays empty or self-contained-only) — a regression adding one must be caught. VERIFY: node --test asserting dependencies has no @adlc/* keys.
- AC4: cursor's bin entry is proven to actually run standalone — pack the tarball to a temp dir, `npm install` it in isolation (or simulate via direct node invocation of the packed file against a temp target repo), and assert it produces the expected scaffold output (.adlc/config.json, .cursor/hooks.json, etc.) without relying on anything outside the packed files. VERIFY: node --test running the real packed CLI end-to-end in a temp repo.
- AC5: docs/integrations/cursor.md and docs/integrations/antigravity.md (and their apps/docs mdx counterparts, if independently authoritative) no longer claim npm publish is entirely absent as an option — the from-source path remains primary until first release, but the eventual npm command is documented accurately (no invented `agy install npm:X`). VERIFY: grep for the updated language; grep for absence of any false `agy install npm:` claim.
- AC6: full root `npm test` exits 0. `node scripts/release.mjs 1.2.1 --publish` is NEVER run in this ticket — no version bump, no tag, no publish. `adlc rails-guard` passes for this ticket's diff.

Suppressions are denied; marker fixtures (if any test needs a test-skip-shaped string, e.g. dot-skip-open-paren) must be assembled by concatenation, mirroring the established convention in plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs. Do not modify plugins/adlc-pi/**, plugins/adlc-opencode/**, packages/**, .github/workflows/**, or plugins/adlc-antigravity/plugin.json's version — all frozen rails below.
title: Make @adlc/cursor-package and @adlc/antigravity-package npm-publishable (release-ready)
